items.text: Rams consider WR Puka Nacua (hip, Q for MNF vs Giants) a pre-game decision after missing practices.
items.why: Hip injury, DNP consecutive days; different from prior psoas.
items.implication: Have pivot ready for MNF; flex if starting.
items.opportunity: If OUT, more TE usage (Ferguson/Parkinson) and WR bump to Mumpfield/Adams; Whittington also doubtful.

items.text: Broncos RB R.J. Harvey (hamstring, Q vs Jaguars) is unlikely to play, per source.
items.opportunity: Increased carries for JK Dobbins and other Broncos RBs.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (cracked rib) practiced Friday, improved steadily; team did not elevate WR, pushing to play with optimism barring setback. Expected flak jacket if active.
items.implication: Likely active vs Raiders; monitor for full role.
items.opportunity: If OUT/limited, QJ and Harris inherit volume (22% shares Week 1 post-exit).

items.text: Raiders elevated TE Chris Myarick with Brock Bowers doubtful (knee/meniscus); expected Week 3.
items.opportunity: Michael Mayer primary TE targets/routes; Jeanty more receiving work.

items.text: Ravens downgraded WR Zay Flowers to OUT for Sunday vs Saints due to hamstring injury.
items.implication: Sit Flowers; look to Ravens pass-catchers for target bump.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for Mark Andrews and other Ravens WRs/TEs.

items.text: Steelers downgraded WR Michael Pittman Jr. to OUT vs Patriots with foot injury.
items.opportunity: Target bump to other Steelers WRs.

items.text: 49ers RB Kaelon Black (groin, Q vs Dolphins) is expected to play, per source.
items.why: Minor, limited but expected; Shanahan noted minor.
items.implication: Viable in deep formats/49ers RB committee.
items.opportunity: Share of rushes in favorable matchup.

items.text: Saints WR Chris Olave (hamstring, Q at Baltimore) is expected to play.
items.opportunity: Full target share expected; Chase Young also expected.

items.text: Bengals elevated QB Josh Johnson with Joe Burrow Q (but expected to play) vs Texans.
items.why: Back issue but expected; backup elevated as precaution.

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins (hamstring) ruled OUT for Sunday.
Cheap WR Volume: Quentin Johnston and Tre Harris project 5+ targets; large roles if McConkey out (22% shares post-exit Wk1) in friendly Raiders matchup. Johnston >5 even if McConkey plays.
items.implication: DFS/streamer value; roster QJ as McConkey pivot.
items.opportunity: Elevated target share/routes if McConkey limited/OUT.

items.text: Loves Kenneth Walker vs IND: 21/24 RB touches through 3Q (74% snaps), 40% routes targeted; Indy gave 163 yds/3 TD to Henry.
items.why: Elite Week 1 usage + soft run matchup.

items.text: Loves Ashton Jeanty @ LAC: 99 utilization Week 1 (tied Bijan), 19% target share recent, 25+ touches 3/4 games.
items.opportunity: Full backfield control + targets, more if Bowers out.

items.text: Loves Bucky Irving vs CLE: RB9 util, 26% target share, all RB RZ touches; CLE allowed 121 rush/4.8 YPC.
Loves Justin Jefferson @ CHI: 37% target share from Wentz Wk1; 93 yds/18 PPG career with Wentz; Bears soft vs WRs.
Hates Travis Etienne @ BAL: Matched Miller rushes Wk1, most pts via air; Kamara expected back squeezes role; underdog script.
Hates Marvin Harrison Jr. vs SEA: Only 8% target share Wk1 (5th on team), zero RZ; SEA tough vs WRs.
Loves Dak Prescott vs WAS: Home 21.3 PPG last yr; WAS torched 14.5 YPC/3 TD passes Wk1; high implied total smash spot.
